In 'an Intro meeting at 3 for 1 hour, called Main', the clause of 'called' is tied to '3', but the words say the meeting is 'called Main', not the hour.
In 'add an Intro meeting titled Main at 3 running 1 hour', 'running' is held as the head of a nominal complement of 'titled', so the clause of 'running 1 hour' is not written.
In 'relabel the Intro meeting to Second', 'Second' is held as a complement of 'leave the room alone' and the 'to' relation ends at that clause, so the new label is lost.
In 'let it run 3', 'it' is held only as the subject of 'run', so the complement of 'let' is lost.
In 'Let the Intro meeting take the title Second', 'the Intro meeting' is held only as the subject of 'take', so the complement of 'Let' is lost.
In 'let Main ride along in the notes', 'Main' is held only as the subject of 'ride', so the complement of 'let' is lost.
In 'whoever owns the Intro meeting', 'whoever' is held as the marker of a relation, but the words make it the subject of 'owns'.
'throw in Main' is left untied, though it continues 'who else is on the Intro meeting?' about the meeting's participants.
In 'it's no longer needed', 'no' is held as a complement of 'needed', but the words make it a negation word grading 'longer', not a thing needed.
In 'if not, remove it', 'not' is held as a discourse word, but it is the negation of an elliptical clause that shares the verb of 'does anyone need the Intro meeting?'.
In 'peek at the calendar', 'peek' is held as a noun in a fragment, and with no other verb the command is lost.
In 'How many calendars are sitting in the meeting invite?', 'invite' is written as the verb and 'sitting' as a nominal, but 'sitting' is the verb and 'invite' heads 'the meeting invite'.
In 'Do we have any schedule-thingies set up over here at all?', 'any schedule-thingies' is held only as the subject of 'set up', so the complement of 'have' is lost.
'while I'm at it' stands before the comma and opens 'is there a calendar marked as shared in there?', but the relation marked 'while' starts at 'how many calendars do we have overall'.
In 'change a meteing Goal', 'Goal' is held as the head with 'meteing' as a dependent, but the words make 'meteing' the noun and 'Goal' the name after it.
sop:

@n1 syntax.nominal dependent="a" head="meteing" dependent="Goal"
